name: Epsilon Indi B

target.name: Epsilon Indi B
target.blurb: Par de enanas marrones T a 12 años luz; ~4.7"/año.
target.why: Movimiento menor que un píxel por temporada y vecina brillante (eps Ind A): prueba de artefactos.

en.why: Sub-pixel motion per season next to a bright star (eps Ind A): an artifact test.

expected.basis: T-dwarf binary ~7.3' from the bright star eps Ind A (ghost/crosstalk risk)

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)

wcs.pixel_convention: 1-based FITS pixel centres; x = column (0 = East edge), y = row (0 = North edge) of the delivered array

pixel_encoding.pixels_b64: little-endian float32, n*n, row-major, row 0 = North, column 0 = East; unit MJy/sr; NaN = no usable measurement
pixel_encoding.flags_b64: little-endian uint32 SPHEREx FLAGS bitmask (nearest native pixel), same orientation; see frame.flag_bits
pixel_encoding.nan_policy: NaN where outside the frame footprint, non-finite, variance <= 0 or flagged ['COLD', 'DICHROIC', 'HOT', 'MISSING_DATA', 'NONFUNC', 'PHANMISS']; all other flags are kept and reported

provenance.citation: This publication makes use of data products from the Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization and Ices Explorer (SPHEREx), which is a joint project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the California Institute of Technology, and is funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. Data retrieved from NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA).
provenance.selection: deterministic time-uniform sample per detector, round-robin across detectors
provenance.transfer: HTTP byte ranges on AWS mirror s3://nasa-irsa-spherex (fallback: IRSA cutout service)
limitations: Each SPHEREx frame samples a source at ONE wavelength (linear variable filter); brightness changes between frames can be colour, not time variability.
Pixels are reprojected with bilinear interpolation; no PSF homogenisation.
lambda_um/bandwidth_um come from the approximate spectral WCS 'W' at the request centre.
Images include zodiacal light (ZODI extension not subtracted).
Quality flags are reported, not hidden; only hard-invalid bits are NaN-masked.

caveats: Predicted positions from Gaia DR3 astrometry (epoch J2016.0); not SPHEREx detections.
Gaia covariances are not propagated; per-epoch errors combine catalog sigmas in quadrature.
Missing radial velocity is assumed 0 km/s.
Geocentric annual parallax included; aberration not applied (astrometric place).
Gaia is incomplete for very red, faint objects (e.g. Y dwarfs such as WISE 0855).

provenance.citation: Gaia Collaboration, Vallenari et al. 2023, A&A 674, A1 (Gaia DR3); ESA Gaia Archive https://gea.esac.esa.int/archive/
provenance.adql: SELECT TOP 2000 source_id, ra, dec, ra_error, dec_error, ref_epoch, pmra, pmdec, pmra_error, pmdec_error, parallax, parallax_error, radial_velocity, phot_g_mean_mag, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 331.09642665, -56.80058587, 0.05833333)) OR (pm > 2790.314 AND 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 331.09642665, -56.80058587, 0.08135848))) ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC

classification.weighting: Akaike weights with chi2 scaled by max(1, best reduced chi2)
caveats: Relative preference among a small template set; the true class may be absent.
Points from different epochs are combined: variability or motion distorts the spectrum.
Star templates are idealized blackbodies, not stellar atmospheres.
The asteroid model is a toy (reflected 5778 K + thermal blackbody).
A 3% fractional calibration error is added in quadrature (assumed).
18 point(s) excluded (saturated, artifact-flagged, or not measured).
10 point(s) without EPSF aperture correction excluded (aperture flux, not total; would bias the fit).
8 point(s) outside common template coverage (1.07-4.97 um used).
Best template still fits poorly (reduced chi2 = 101.0).

frames.method: spherex.live native byte-range cutouts (IRSA cutout service fallback)

provenance.method: forced circular aperture, sigma-clipped median annulus background, VARIANCE errors, EPSF aperture correction; forced PSF fit with Gaia neighbours at fixed positions when blended (flux_method per point)

checks.label: Saturation (OVERFLOW/NONLINEAR/BLOOM)
checks.evidence_source: SPHEREx L2 FLAGS (MSKN header definitions) at the aperture

checks.label: Ghosts, crosstalk, persistence, transients
checks.detail: 17/79 frames carry artifact flags: HALOx16, PERSISTx1, TRANSIENTx13
checks.evidence_source: SPHEREx L2 FLAGS (MSKN header definitions) at the aperture

checks.label: Detection (S/N >= 5)
checks.detail: Detected at S/N >= 5 in 59 clean frames of 79.
checks.evidence_source: Forced aperture photometry with VARIANCE errors

checks.label: Gaia DR3 counterpart
checks.detail: Gaia DR3 6412596012146801152 (G = 18.03 mag): predicted position 0.34 arcsec from the query position (prediction, not detection).
checks.evidence_source: Gaia DR3 (propagated with PM + parallax to the frame epoch)

checks.label: Blending with known neighbours
checks.detail: No other Gaia DR3 source within 12.3 arcsec.
checks.evidence_source: Gaia DR3 neighbours (propagated) within the blend radius

checks.label: Known solar-system object
checks.detail: No known SSO within 12 arcsec at 12 queried epochs.

checks.label: Measured vs predicted motion
checks.detail: Measured 6.34 arcsec (1.03 px) between seasons 0 and 3 (sigma 0.43/0.43 arcsec). Predicted 6.31 arcsec. Consistent within 3 sigma.
checks.evidence_source: Season centroids (pixel-integrated Gaussian fit) vs Gaia prediction

data.method: chi2 of matched-wavelength flux differences between seasons

checks.label: Spectral class
checks.detail: Best: SDSSp J1346-00 (T6.5, observed JWST) (relative weight 100%, reduced chi2 101.0).
checks.evidence_source: Template chi2 fit (Beiler+2024 JWST brown dwarfs, blackbodies, asteroid toy)

verdict.summary: Known source (Gaia DR3 6412596012146801152) with flux changes between seasons. Variability is tentative; systematics (flags, few matched pairs, poor spectral fit) are not excluded.
verdict.summary_es: Fuente conocida (Gaia DR3 6412596012146801152) con cambios de flujo entre temporadas. La variabilidad es tentativa: no se descartan sistemáticos (marcas, pocos pares emparejados, mal ajuste espectral).
verdict.confidence_method: heuristic from check outcomes (see spherex/science/verdict.py), not a probability
